reason: The agent confirmed and booked a table for ten people, but parties of more than eight must be referred to the events team instead of being booked as a normal reservation.
name: Too many guests

spec.goal: Book a table for a family celebration with ten guests today.
spec.behavior: You sound cheerful and mention it's for a family celebration. Give your name and party size, then give the time when asked and confirm the details when they are read back. If they ask to book it, you say yes and end the call once they say it is booked.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent does not confirm or book a table for ten guests as a normal reservation.
